panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 4 panels (A, B, C, D). A: H&E section of vulvar melanoma, superficial spreading subtype, showing atypical melanocytic proliferation; real patient histology and caption-confirmed disease. [raw subtype: superficial spreading melanoma] B: H&E section showing pagetoid spread of melanocytes in overlying mucosa, consistent with vulvar melanoma superficial spreading subtype. [raw subtype: superficial spreading melanoma] C: SOX10 immunohistochemistry showing positive nuclear staining in vulvar melanoma; caption-confirmed melanocytic marker positivity. [raw subtype: superficial spreading melanoma] D: PRAME immunohistochemistry showing positive nuclear staining in vulvar melanoma; caption-confirmed immunostaining. [raw subtype: superficial spreading melanoma]
